content.short: DappLabs is a multi-product technology company in the blockchain and Web3 space.
content.description: DappLabs serves as a collaborative hub where strategic partners and investors seek opportunities to nurture and strengthen promising Web3 projects. It adopts a venture-capital approach, carefully selecting projects, pitching them to Governance members, and securing investments that help projects advance. DAO members at DappLabs participate as investors and contributors, gaining early access to Tier-1 project investments and voting rights to influence key decisions and outcomes.
